name: Combobox
description: A text input with a popup list of suggestions that narrows as you type. Use it when the list is long enough that typing is faster than scrolling, or when people may enter a value that isn't in the list.

elements.name: Input
elements.description: Text field; typing filters the suggestions

elements.name: Listbox
elements.description: Popup of matching options; opens on typing or with the Down arrow

elements.name: Toggle button
elements.description: ▾ button that opens the full list without typing

elements.name: Hint or error text
elements.description: Says whether free text is allowed, or what went wrong

usageNotes: Choose a Combobox over a Select when people know what they want and typing is faster, such as picking an airport from hundreds. For short lists, a Select or Radio group is simpler.
Follow the APG Combobox pattern: focus stays in the input, arrow keys move through options using aria-activedescendant, Enter picks one and Escape closes the popup.
Tell screen reader users how many results match, for example with a polite live region, because the list changes as they type.
Decide whether values outside the list are allowed and say so in the hint. If only listed values are valid, show an error when the typed text matches nothing.
<input list> with <datalist> gives native suggestions with no script, but browsers filter and style it inconsistently. Test it before relying on it.
